purpose: Measure only the effect of the four Phase 1.3.1 condition edits before UI work. This is not the retained global FIX threshold sweep.
requiredMetrics: 18-24 ending count, share of completions, and endings per 1000 runs
25-34 ending count, share of completions, and endings per 1000 runs
65+ ending share of completions for regression awareness
sudden faction ending count and share of faction endings
committed-ladder faction ending count and share
Last Posture contact -> ENGAGED -> COMMITTED -> ending counts
personalized faction event after OPTED_OUT/CLOSED count

desiredDirection: Last Posture COMMITTED count is greater than zero.
18-24 endings are meaningfully observable rather than effectively zero.
Sudden faction endings remain a clear minority of faction endings.
Faction-caused ending share does not rebound anywhere near the Phase 1.2 48.6% result.
All faction FSM/safe-exit/pre-25 correctness counters remain zero.
interpretationGuardrails.youngEndingCalibrationBandForReviewOnly: Roughly 5-15% of completed endings is a useful H2A-observability range, not a frozen game target.

retentionPolicy.note: All skipped harnesses remain part of H2B / larger balance regression. The LOW/MID/HIGH sweep is specifically the next larger calibration after this micro-patch if the condition edits behave safely.

stopCondition: Report results and stop. Do not choose global thresholds and do not begin React/UI implementation in the same task.
